body:

Complete signed paid jobs fall **110,145→110,111**, with 22,461 productive jobs and surplus 1,424 unchanged; no extra paid MOVE.

**Changed hypothesis:** U must uniformly cover both words' complete private INIT/CLEAR, arbitrary old junk and reachable numerical residuals, atomic return and nonaliasing, within the same finite already-charged tariff. The combined lifetime item is 4,000 ordinary source units per lifetime pair; INIT/CLEAR each receive 32 scalar-service units and the retained normalized 2^20 step coefficient with all original size/precision factors. All storage, tape and other work remain covered by that supplier bound. **U is unimplemented; #7620's original erasure premise is not proved to imply it, and same-original-premise dominance remains unestablished.** The five inherited framework assumptions remain.

One erased row changes: owner 1557 at source 43229/candidate 43223, chart 595, becomes `-e451+e1495` instead of `-e451-3/2e902-3/2e985+e1495`. Twelve owned scalar interfaces change. Full records and all 167 regenerated relation certificates are supplied. These relations do not implement physical erasure.
